name: PERSONA-Bench
description: PERSONA-Bench evaluates a model's ability to adopt and maintain a specified persona in conversational settings, testing persona-consistent response selection and generation. It measures whether model outputs align with provided persona attributes across context turns.
evaluation_method: accuracy for selection tasks; human evaluation/consistency metrics often used for generated responses
reputation: A niche benchmark used by researchers studying persona consistency and conversational alignment, with modest adoption in dialogue-focused evaluations.
